name: ceki-real-browser-fetch
title: Real Browser Fetch — protected pages via warmed Chrome sessions
description: Fetch pages that block ordinary scrapers. Requests run through a real, already-warmed Chrome profile rented from Ceki — genuine fingerprint, real cookies, persistent session across runs. Returns HTML, cookies and screenshots.

page-fetched.eventDescription: Charged once per successfully retrieved page (HTML). Failed fetches are not charged.

screenshot.eventDescription: Charged once per successfully captured screenshot (PNG, full page when requested), including pages behind a Cloudflare challenge. A screenshot is a separate deliverable: it costs a full-page render and returns an image. Failed captures are not charged.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once when the Actor starts.
